message: The 4 November 2026, 20:00 SGT scheduled watchlist edition is published. The exact-commit Pages run succeeded; live latest data and the dated full report match SHA-256 receipts. This verifies this scheduled execution, not future runs. All twelve regular closes and 72 adjusted-close baselines were freshly reconfirmed. Seven separately dated premarket observations before cutoff are included; five later quotes were excluded. Saved observations are not live. New research covers Google’s planned Malaysian investment and Meta’s preliminary euro offering, plus a clearly shared Reuters market update. Google’s matching original release was not retrieved; Meta final pricing and settlement remain unverified. Source coverage is partial. The existing schema covers the original twelve names; SPY, QQQ, TLT, IEI and IEF are not represented as verified coverage. Separate (A) chat delivery remains unverified. Refreshing this page reloads saved files and does not create research.
